title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
description: Find the length of the longest substring with all unique characters.

data.text: Given `s`, return the length of the longest substring without repeating characters.

data.title: Check all substrings O(n^3)
Sliding Window O(n)

data.caption: The sliding window expands right and shrinks left whenever a duplicate character appears inside the window.
data.definition:
graph TB
    A[s=abcabcbb] --> B[left=0 right=0]
    B --> C[Add a]
    C --> D[Add b]
    D --> E[Add c]
    E --> F[window=abc max=3]
    F --> G[right=3 char=a duplicate]
    G --> H[remove s[left++] until a gone]
    H --> I[window=bca]
    style F fill:#e8f5e9,stroke:#2e7d32
    style H fill:#fff3e0,stroke:#e65100

data.title: What improved?
data.text: We slide a window and shrink from the left when duplicates appear. Each character enters and leaves the window at most once, giving O(n) time.
